templates.why_chosen: An abstract agent-loop diagram (a), a concrete annotated text trace (b), and a stacked latency bar chart (c) are three genuinely unlike kinds under one figure, exactly the box-plus-workflow-plus-plot mix this template is built for.
templates.what_to_learn: Let the dominant architecture panel set the organizing idea (the dashed Region A/B boundary) that the unlike trace and chart panels beside it echo, and give each differently-styled panel a light divider or frame, since running three visual languages together with none, as here, blurs where one panel ends and the next begins.
